headline.caveat: approximately $3B one-time distribution from the JV to Meta at close

nature_md: At the formation of the Hyperion JV, Meta received a one-time distribution of approximately $3B from the vehicle, funded out of the ~$7B cash contributed by Blue Owl-managed funds. Economically, Meta monetized part of the campus assets it seeded into the JV — cash came *back* to Meta from a structure created to finance Meta's own infrastructure, in the same transaction that moved $27B of related debt off Meta's books.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Distribution paid by the JV out of contributed equity capital — a return of capital at the vehicle level, not an operating outflow.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Cash inflow to Meta. Distributions from an equity-method JV reduce the carrying value of Meta's investment (return of capital) rather than flowing through revenue; specifics of any gain recognition on contributed assets are not separately disclosed in the announcement.
